origin: founding-agents-site #14: the product lead named eight one-way doors, recommended on each, and settled none; the founder then chose differently on all eight
summary: An idea that implies a CSS framework, a site generator and a new host. The product lead writes the brief, names each as a decision for the founder, and settles none.

issues.title: Make it easy to add pages
issues.body: The site is one hand-written page. The team's roles and a page per run would mean many more pages. Rebuild it so a page is quick to add: maybe a CSS framework, a site generator, and a host that shows each change before it merges.
